summary: Human Entertainment and Working Designs' PlayStation tactical RPG about fantasy mecha called ATACs.

entries.title: Vanguard Bandits

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and PGXP; keep 4:3 unless using a verified widescreen patch.

primary.why: Vanguard Bandits is documented as a PlayStation-only tactical RPG, so the best route is the original release with PS1 emulation upscaling.
primary.how_to_play: Use a PlayStation disc or legally dumped image in DuckStation with high internal resolution, PGXP geometry correction, and the original aspect ratio.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation 3D tactical RPG presentation with emulator upscaling options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one official platform is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remake or remaster documented.
